sloka: निमित्तानि अमनोज्ञानि तेन सीदति ते मनः ।सर्वथा कुशलम् सूत दुर्लभम् मम बन्धुषु ॥२-७१-३१॥
transliteration: nimittāni amanojñāni tena sīdati te manaḥ ।sarvathā kuśalam sūta durlabham mama bandhuṣu ॥2-71-31॥

translations.english: ﻿ I do not see anywhere, O charioteer the wellbeing, of my kinsmen. Hence I feel deluded and my heart is filled with grief.
